title: Zenith Motors to acquire Orion Steel for $2.1 billion
raw_text_snippet: Zenith Motors Ltd has agreed to acquire Orion Steel Corp in a deal valued at $2.1 billion, the companies said on 14 March 2026. Orion Steel Corp, a subsidiary of Titan Chemicals Corp, makes specialty alloys for the automotive industry. Zenith Motors said the acquisition will secure its supply chain. Titan Chemicals Corp's subsidiary Orion Steel employs about 9,000 people.

title: Apex Pharma and Helios Energy to merge
raw_text_snippet: Apex Pharma Inc and Helios Energy PLC have agreed to merge in an all-stock transaction worth $7.8 billion. Helios Energy PLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Meridian Insurance Co, will become part of the combined entity.
